verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1971 (UK).

notes.text:
The LP is issued in a white poly-lined inner sleeve. Package also includes replica lyric sheet insert and plain white (unlined) paper inner sleeve (presumably replicating original inner sleeve).
Front of cover laminated, back side non-laminated (replicating original release).
Some copies have a "Made in Germany" sticker on the rear sleeve.
Barcode is a sticker (for the nearly similar version but with the barcode printed directly on the back cover see

).
2015 is printed on centre labels and sleeve, but the LP wasn't released until February 2016.

Catalog number as 0825646289448 (DB69733) on spine.
Catalog number as DB 69733 on back cover.
Catalog number as DBXL1 (DB69733) (0825646289448) on labels.

Tracks B1/B2 listed as medley on insert, separately on labels and back cover.
Tracks A2/A3 listed as medley on insert and labels, separately on back cover. Track numbering on back cover lists "Life On Mars?" as A3, "Kooks" as A4, "Quicksand" as A5.
Track A4 title on insert: Life On Mars

Runouts are etched, Optimal plating symbols (e.g., △=F, △=3, 3, 5, +2, 12, etc.) are mirrored.
